A blank Quarto document with Python. `quarto preview` renders it again on
every save and the page reloads itself.

```{python}
import numpy as np

x = np.random.default_rng(1).normal(size=500)
print(f"mean {x.mean():.3f}, sd {x.std(ddof=1):.3f}")
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3))
ax.hist(x, bins=30)
ax.set_title("500 draws from a normal distribution");
```
